facts.fact: 露台上摆开了接风下午茶：一罐茶和一桌“我”几个月来没见过的丰盛吃食。
facts.anchor: A tea caddy had been set out on the terrace next to a table holding more food than I’d seen in months

facts.fact: Olivia 第一次用旁人的眼光看自己：年轻、没钱没前途、没有未婚夫，如今连家也没有。
facts.anchor: For the first time, I saw myself as others did

facts.fact: 阔绰宾客的名字像一把把彩纸屑反复抛向 Olivia，她不加笑容一一低声寒暄。
facts.anchor: the names of swank guests repeatedly tossed at me like handfuls of confetti

facts.fact: Tippy 自述儿时看过 Olivia 的父亲演 Peter Pan，被按去坐到他腿上，尖叫到流鼻血、不得不请医生。
facts.anchor: I saw your father in Peter Pan

facts.fact: Tippy 掏出单片眼镜打量 Olivia，断言她的真名是 Miranda，并背诵《暴风雨》里的台词。
facts.anchor: Your name is in fact Miranda.

facts.fact: Tippy 说 Dickie Soames 也到场了，正围着 Lady Rondell 打转，他想不出对方是怎么弄到请柬的。
facts.anchor: I spotted him hanging around Lady Rondell.

facts.fact: Tippy 问 Simon 两位姑娘是不是“也是那样的”，Simon 点头作答，Tippy 便收起单片眼镜放心道别。
facts.anchor: Simon nodded. Tippy returned his monocle to his pocket.

facts.fact: 临别时 Tippy 唤 Olivia 作“美丽的 Penthesilea”，叮嘱她箭不离弦，朝她飞了个吻离开。
